title: Make it so that shift+enter expands input box and goes to next line; make a stop button far right that allows you to ca…

items.content: Shift+Enter newline + multi-line input rendering, and clickable Stop button at far right of input box (aura-ui-terminal)

summary: The help overlay has a fixed height, so the two extra lines clip it. I'll put the new key on the existing Enter line and drop the Stop line so the line count stays the same.
